entries.input: Every real function continuous on $[a, b]$ is the uniform limit of polynomials: for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a polynomial $P$ with $|P(x) - f(x)| < \varepsilon$ on $[a, b]$.
entries.name: WeierstrassApproximationTheorem
entries.binders: (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
entries.conclusion: ∃ p : Polynomial ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |p.eval x - f x| < ε
entries.title: Weierstrass approximation theorem

entries.input: Let $K$ be a compact metric space and $\mathcal{A}$ an algebra of real continuous functions on $K$ containing the constants and separating points. Then $\mathcal{A}$ is uniformly dense in the space of all real continuous functions on $K$.
entries.name: StoneWeierstrassReal
entries.binders: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (A : Subalgebra ℝ (ContinuousMap X ℝ)) (hsep : A.SeparatesPoints)
entries.title: Stone–Weierstrass theorem
entries.witness_note: The statement quantifies over a space or a function type through implicit type binders and instance binders, which `∃` cannot close, so no witness of the checked shape exists. The hypotheses are satisfiable: `X = Unit`, `A = ⊤`.

entries.input: Let $K$ be a compact metric space and $\mathcal{A}$ a self-adjoint algebra of complex continuous functions on $K$ containing the constants and separating points. Then $\mathcal{A}$ is uniformly dense in the space of all complex continuous functions on $K$.
entries.name: StoneWeierstrassComplex
entries.binders: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (ContinuousMap X ℂ)) (hsep : A.SeparatesPoints)
entries.title: Stone–Weierstrass theorem, complex form
entries.witness_note: The statement quantifies over a space or a function type through implicit type binders and instance binders, which `∃` cannot close, so no witness of the checked shape exists. The hypotheses are satisfiable: `X = Unit`, `A = ⊤`.

entries.input: If $f$ is continuous on $[0, 1]$ and $\int_0^1 f(x) x^n\,dx = 0$ for every $n = 0, 1, 2, \dots$, then $f = 0$ on $[0, 1]$.
entries.name: VanishingMomentsImplyZero
entries.binders: (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 1)) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x * x ^ n = 0)
entries.witness: ⟨0, continuousOn_const, fun n => by simp, trivial⟩

entries.input: If $f$ is integrable on $[a, b]$ with $f^2$ integrable, then for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a polynomial $P$ with $\int_a^b |f - P|^2 < \varepsilon$.
entries.name: SquareIntegrableFunctionApproximatedByPolynomialsInMean
entries.binders: (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b) (hf2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a b) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
entries.conclusion: ∃ p : Polynomial ℝ, ∫ x in a..b, (f x - p.eval x) ^ 2 < ε
entries.witness: ⟨0, 0, 1, zero_le_one, intervalIntegrable_const, by simpa using intervalIntegrable_const, 1, one_pos, trivial⟩

entries.input: Let $P_0 = 0$ and $P_{n+1}(x) = P_n(x) + (x^2 - P_n(x)^2)/2$. Then $P_n(x) \to |x|$ uniformly on $[-1, 1]$.
entries.name: PolynomialIterationConvergingToAbsoluteValue
entries.witness: ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (fun _ => 0) (fun _ Q x => Q x + (x ^ 2 - (Q x) ^ 2) / 2) n, rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, trivial⟩
